## 3000 - 3006

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03000">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03000">

#### 3001 BI - Data contains sum of duplicate records (effective date) (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3002 BI - Imported original data obscured by existing edited data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03002">

This exception is generated for two specific cases:

- If a record is auto-estimated and edited, and then the original record comes in, and the flag to replace Auto Estimated data is set to Y.
- If a record is estimated, and then the original record comes in, and the auto estimate flag to replace Auto Estimated data is set to N.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03003">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3003 BI - Duplicate record detected</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03003">

This exception is generated during the Daylight Saving Time period for “Fall Back.” This exception will be generated if a meter is not “Adjusted for DST” (Meter Editor; Imports tab) and duplicate records are imported which is very likely to happen for Fall back.

When Adjusted for DST is enabled, FLOWCAL will also flag the first chronological hour where a fall back time change took place so that if a second instance of duplicate records is found within the Fall Back time frame exception 3003 will be generated appropriately.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3004 BI - Imported data does not match database original data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03004">

This exception is generated with Batch Snap functionality in the Meter Editor, Imports tab. Using the snap functionality to adjust a batch start date or a batch end date may cause the batch to conflict with a batch record that is already in the database. The comparison will be based on the following fields:

- Batch Start Date
- Batch End Date
- Indicated Volume (IV)
- Gross Standard Volume (GSV)
- Net Standard Volume (NSV)
- Mass

If IV, GSV, NSV or mass in the file is undefined, then it will not be included in the comparison. All fields must otherwise match. 

When this happens, the batch will not be imported and the exception will be generated. 

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3005 BI - Original periodic data not Imported due to existing overlapping periodic data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03005">

This exception is generated to inform the user that a liquid meter periodic record in time trails record span was not imported because it overlaps with an existing original periodic record. One exception is generated for each periodic record that was not imported in this fashion, on the existing periodic record that was already in database. This exception is generated to prevent overlapping periodic records from causing erroneous virtual batches to be displayed in the Volume Editor. This exception is most often caused by getting late periodic records.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3006 BI - Batch import failed; batch snapped to an effective date of existing batch</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03006">

Using the snap functionality to adjust a periodic record’s date may cause the record to conflict with a periodic record already in the database from a previous import. If this happens, this exception will be generated, indicating that the record cannot be imported.

</div>
